entries.note: Delivery status: the parcel was created through the API. Listed in the status classifier of L-POST's API manual.
Delivery status: the parcel was added to a handover act. Listed in the status classifier of L-POST's API manual.

entries.wording: Готово к отгрузке на склад Л-Пост
entries.note: Delivery status for a parcel dropped at a pickup point: ready to go from there to the L-POST warehouse. The same code in the return classifier means a return is ready to be sent back. Listed in the status classifier of L-POST's API manual.
Delivery status for a parcel dropped at a pickup point: sent on to the L-POST warehouse. Listed in the status classifier of L-POST's API manual.
The shipment containing the parcel arrived at the warehouse; also used for returns. Listed in the status classifier of L-POST's API manual.
The parcel was accepted box by box at the L-POST warehouse; also used for returns. Listed in the status classifier of L-POST's API manual.
Sent from the L-POST warehouse to the delivery point. Listed in the status classifier of L-POST's API manual.

At the last-mile point: ready for collection at a pickup point, or waiting there for the courier when the order is delivered to the door. Listed in the status classifier of L-POST's API manual. The adapter stages a courier delivery waiting there as in transit.
Courier deliveries only: handed to the courier for delivery. Listed in the status classifier of L-POST's API manual.
Courier deliveries only: handed to the recipient; not final, since part of the order can still come back as a return. Listed in the status classifier of L-POST's API manual.
Final status: all or part of the order was bought out by the recipient. Listed in the status classifier of L-POST's API manual.
Final status: a full return, after the storage period at the delivery point ran out or at the customer's or sender's request. Listed in the status classifier of L-POST's API manual.
All processes for the parcel, financial ones included, are closed; not a delivery event. Listed in the status classifier of L-POST's API manual.

Return status: the return is ready to be sent to the L-POST warehouse. Listed in the status classifier of L-POST's API manual. The tracking page lists a return's statuses beside the delivery's, and a return of some items can follow a delivery of the rest, so it has no stage; a full return is the delivery's own CANCELLED.

Return status: the return was handed back to the sender. Listed in the status classifier of L-POST's API manual. The tracking page lists a return's statuses beside the delivery's, and a return of some items can follow a delivery of the rest, so it has no stage; a full return is the delivery's own CANCELLED.

entries.wording: Готово к отгрузке со склада Интернет-магазина
entries.note: The tracking page's wording for ACT_CREATED in its order summary, with status id 4: the parcel is on a handover act and the shop has yet to hand it over.
A row of the tracking page's status history: the order was created (CREATED).

entries.wording: Готово к отгрузке со склада Интернет-магазина
entries.note: A row of the tracking page's status history (ACT_CREATED): the shop has yet to hand the parcel over.
A row of the tracking page's status history and its summary status (CANCELLED): a full return, also for an order the shop never handed over.
